item.title: In 1950, Long Beach opened Veterans Memorial Stadium; sold to its city college for $1 in 1987
item.description: Long Beach City College is embarking on an exciting $250 million redevelopment of its stadium. The decades-old Veterans Memorial Stadium will be replaced by a cutting-edge sports precinct that spans 18 acres. This new venue will feature a 10,000-seat outdoor stadium, an indoor arena, and specialized track and field facilities, along with dedicated football fields. With funding from Measure LB, the project is set to be unveiled in summer 2029.

item.title: At 17, British apprentice Tom Lear began building a 12.5-sq-m tiny home on a trailer
item.description: Over the span of three years, a resourceful young carpenter dedicated his skills to constructing a mobile home crafted from reclaimed materials. With a budget of around six thousand pounds, this innovative micro-home serves as an affordable housing solution for young individuals, granting him both independence and a life free from debt. His achievement is a testament to creativity and sustainability.

item.title: 'We will never, ever forget': Trump commemorates 25th anniversary of 9/11 terrorist attacks
item.description: On the anniversary of 9/11, leaders across the United States honored the victims and reflected on the impact of the tragedy on current foreign policy. Speaking at the Pentagon, President Trump paid homage to the fallen and reaffirmed the nation’s determination, particularly in its dealings with Iran. Defense Secretary Hegseth reinforced this message, relating the historical attacks to the ongoing war on terror.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: A 27-year-old Tennessee diesel mechanic wanted to farm full-time; solar sites gave his sheep...
item.description: Solar grazing offers new opportunities for small livestock farmers across the American South. This practice uses sheep to manage vegetation beneath solar panels, benefiting both farmers and solar companies. Farmers gain access to pasture and income, while companies reduce maintenance costs and equipment damage risks. A Tennessee mechanic became a full-time farmer after securing grazing access to over 400 acres.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Thames Valley Police uncover £1.3m cannabis farm in abandoned BHS store in Slough with 1,700 plants
item.description: Thames Valley Police uncovered a £1.3 million cannabis factory inside a disused BHS store in Slough, finding more than 1,700 plants across two floors. The crop had a potential yield of 150.27kg and an estimated street value of £1.288 million. Two men pleaded guilty and were sentenced to 14 months in prison.

item.title: 49 days before 9/11, a businessman took Twin Towers' lease; 25 years later, the rebuilding nears end
item.description: The final commercial office tower at the World Trade Center site is actively being built as the new global headquarters for American Express. This project has emerged after extensive planning and has navigated numerous hurdles. It acts as a tribute to the lives lost and rekindles commercial activity in Lower Manhattan, representing a crucial milestone in the comprehensive post-9/11 redevelopment plan.

item.title: California officers found 194 abandoned Dungeness crab traps off two rivers; violations wasted...
item.description: Two fishermen faced license suspensions and permit revocations for four years. Wildlife officers recovered 194 abandoned Dungeness crab traps off the coast. These traps caused significant waste and entanglement risks for marine wildlife. Investigations revealed serious violations including untagged gear and missed servicing requirements. This action highlights the ongoing problem of ghost fishing and its environmental impact.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Australian SPF50+ sunscreen tests as low as SPF 4; formula maker faces multimillion-dollar lawsuits
item.description: An Australian sunscreen manufacturer is facing multimillion-dollar legal claims after 20 products using its base formula were recalled for failing to meet SPF claims. Ultra Violette is seeking millions after tests of its SPF50+ sunscreen returned results as low as SPF 2.9 and 4. Wild Child Laboratories entered liquidation in August.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Builders hauled 25-ton stones 11 miles to create the ‘Devil’s Arrows’
item.description: Recent studies indicate that the Neolithic builders of the Devil's Arrows transported massive 25-tonne stones from Brimham Rocks, located 18 kilometers away, rather than using nearby glacial deposits. This geological research has resolved a persistent mystery regarding the stones' lineage. Additionally, a previously unaccounted for stone has been traced to a medieval cross found in Aldborough village, reinforcing local folklore about their historical significance.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What happened to Doja Cat? Twitch livestream leaves fans deeply concerned
item.description: Doja Cat's latest Twitch livestream has left fans worried due to her lack of clarity and focus. The rapper shared feelings of exhaustion regarding her music career and interactions with fans, which raised eyebrows following her earlier admissions about battling alcohol and marijuana issues. However, she later took to social media to reassure her supporters that she was, in fact, doing well.

item.title: Two days after Norway King Harald's funeral, his sister princess Astrid passes away
item.description: Princess Astrid of Norway has sadly passed away at the age of ninety-four. Just two days before her death, she graced her brother King Harald V's state funeral, attended by many who honored the late monarch. King Harald V's passing marked a significant moment in Norwegian history, concluding the period of national mourning. This event was also Astrid's final farewell in a public capacity.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: 25 years after 9/11, the WTC's final office tower is rising; it's a 55-story, 1,226-foot building
item.description: Construction has officially begun on the last commercial office tower at the World Trade Center site. This impressive 55-story structure will be the new global headquarters for American Express. Spanning nearly two million square feet, it’s projected to be fully operational by 2031, contributing billions to the economy and creating thousands of new jobs. This marks a pivotal milestone in the site's redevelopment after 25 years.

item.title: Scientists fitted GPS collars to 17 lions and 14 hyenas expecting hyenas to follow lions
item.description: A groundbreaking study suggests that it's the male lions that approach spotted hyenas, contrary to the belief that hyenas seek out lion remains for food. In fact, spotted hyenas are known to back away from lions, prioritizing their safety. This finding highlights the importance of spatial avoidance in hyena behavior, emphasizing their adaptive strategies to circumvent confrontations with such powerful hunters.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk
